title: Aeroplane with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sky-friendly nothing, just plane -->
  <!-- wings behind body -->
  <path d='M30 55 L8 68 L16 70 L42 60 Z' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <path d='M30 55 L8 68 L16 70 L42 60 Z' fill='none' stroke='#B3E5FC' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M70 55 L92 68 L84 70 L58 60 Z' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <path d='M70 55 L92 68 L84 70 L58 60 Z' fill='none' stroke='#B3E5FC' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d='M20 48 L10 30 L18 30 L30 44 Z' fill='#FF7043'/>
  <path d='M20 48 L10 30 L18 30 L30 44 Z' fill='none' stroke='#FFAB91' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- body fuselage -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='34' ry='13' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='34' ry='13' fill='none' stroke='#FFF59D' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- cockpit window -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='46' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#29B6F6'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='46' rx='9' ry='6' fill='none' stroke='#81D4FA' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- nose cap -->
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='50' rx='4' ry='11' fill='#FF7043'/>
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='50' rx='4' ry='11' fill='none' stroke='#FFAB91' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- smiling face on body -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='46' r='2.6' fill='#1A237E'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='46' r='1.1' fill='#B3E5FC'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='46' r='2.6' fill='#1A237E'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='46' r='1.1' fill='#B3E5FC'/>
  <path d='M36 54 Q45 61 54 54' fill='none' stroke='#D84315' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='51' r='2.2' fill='#FF8A65'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='51' r='2.2' fill='#FF8A65'/>
  <!-- little engine pods under wings -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='63' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#78909C'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='63' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#78909C'/>
</svg>
